page.layout: One printed page, cut at the right edge. Running head at top. Main text in one column: first a title block (IOANNIS QVELINI SO... dalisc harissimi, Memoriae.) followed by a poem of italic lines; then a rule, a second title (IOANNIS DAMPETRI, MO... nialium ...), and a poem in roman lines. A catchword-like fragment "Obef..." stands at the lower right, cut off, and is part of the running text edge. No notes in the margins.

main_text.head: IOANNIS QVELINI SO[?] dalis charissimi, Memoriæ.

p.i: Ille, inquam, in media senex iuuenta,
Non quas fonte tuo hauserat, nec illis
Sed quas, dum Vigiles terit lucernas,
Sic illum Vt sub aquis malis peremptum,

main_text.head: IOANNIS. DAMPETRI, MO[?] nialium apud Magdalenam Aureliæ Rectori, poetarum in scribendis Hen decasyllabis facile Principis, Memoriæ
main_text.p: CLaufus cœnobio latebat olim, Ille Dampetrus optimus Virorum, Princepsque Hendecasyllabôn poëta, Et clausus pariter latebat idem Mole corporea, haud quidem, (fatemur)

page.notes: Right side of the scan is cut off; line ends are lost and several words are truncated (marked [?]). The catchword-like "Obef" at lower right is partly lost. Verse layout as printed in italics where shown.
